comment: Canonical collectionname validation matrix, shared by the Python (database.clickhouse.validate_collectionname) and Rust (api::admin::collections::collectionname_valid) implementations. Both runtimes validate independently, so both test suites load this one list: tests/unit/test_db_naming.py (always) and api/admin/collections.rs tests (when main_services is reachable from the cargo workspace, i.e. on a dev checkout). Max length is 48; the 48-x name is valid, the 49-x name invalid. No '-': Manticore table names are interpolated unquoted, so dashed collection names would not parse.
